node.label: Banking, RBI & disinvestment
node.summary: RBI measures, bank sales and financial inclusion.

facts.text: NPCI told the SC that **'zero MDR' on all UPI transactions is unsustainable**; the new **0.4% MDR** applies only to Person-to-Merchant transactions **above ₹2,000** (about **4%** of merchant transactions); P2P and small P2M stay free. UPI processed **24.51 billion** transactions worth **₹29.82 lakh crore** in August 2026 alone.
facts.plain: NPCI told the SC that 'zero MDR' on all UPI transactions is unsustainable; the new 0.4% MDR applies only to Person-to-Merchant transactions above ₹2,000 (about 4% of merchant transactions); P2P and small P2M stay free. UPI processed 24.51 billion transactions worth ₹29.82 lakh crore in August 2026 alone.

facts.text: **IRDAI** was set up under the **IRDA Act, 1999**; its HQ is in **Hyderabad**.
facts.plain: IRDAI was set up under the IRDA Act, 1999; its HQ is in Hyderabad.

facts.text: **IRDAI** set **15 Dec 2026** for general insurers to offer new car and two-wheeler owners a **four-layer motor policy**: third-party and owner's personal accident (mandatory), plus optional occupant liability, occupant accident and own damage, following SC directions.
facts.plain: IRDAI set 15 Dec 2026 for general insurers to offer new car and two-wheeler owners a four-layer motor policy: third-party and owner's personal accident (mandatory), plus optional occupant liability, occupant accident and own damage, following SC directions.

facts.text: **SBI** was formed in **1955** by nationalising the **Imperial Bank of India** (itself formed in 1921).
facts.plain: SBI was formed in 1955 by nationalising the Imperial Bank of India (itself formed in 1921).

facts.text: **SBI** Q2 net profit rose **14.3%** to **₹23,038 crore**; GNPA ratio **1.39%**, NIM 3.11%. SBI chairman: **C.S. Setty**.
facts.plain: SBI Q2 net profit rose 14.3% to ₹23,038 crore; GNPA ratio 1.39%, NIM 3.11%. SBI chairman: C.S. Setty.

facts.text: Congress asked the government to halt the **IDBI Bank** sale to **Fairfax Financial Holdings** (Canada) and sought a **JPC** probe into its valuation.
facts.plain: Congress asked the government to halt the IDBI Bank sale to Fairfax Financial Holdings (Canada) and sought a JPC probe into its valuation.

facts.text: RBI KYC update camps run **21 Oct to 31 Dec 2026**; a self-declaration is enough if nothing has changed.
facts.plain: RBI KYC update camps run 21 Oct to 31 Dec 2026; a self-declaration is enough if nothing has changed.

facts.text: India's headline CPI inflation, which hit multi-year lows in 2025, edged back up to **5.54% by September 2026** — still within the RBI's 2-6% inflation-targeting band, though a reminder that real returns on bank deposits stay thin.
facts.plain: India's headline CPI inflation, which hit multi-year lows in 2025, edged back up to 5.54% by September 2026 — still within the RBI's 2-6% inflation-targeting band, though a reminder that real returns on bank deposits stay thin.

facts.text: IDBI Bank was majority-owned by **LIC** and the Centre; the stake on sale combines the government's and LIC's holdings. LIC became its promoter in **2019**, and the RBI recategorised IDBI as a **private sector bank** that year.
facts.plain: IDBI Bank was majority-owned by LIC and the Centre; the stake on sale combines the government's and LIC's holdings. LIC became its promoter in 2019, and the RBI recategorised IDBI as a private sector bank that year.

facts.text: The government approved selling a **60.72%** stake in **IDBI Bank** to Canada's **Fairfax Financial Holdings** for about **₹53,000 crore**; Rahul Gandhi opposed it, citing a 2003 promise to keep 50%. FM Sitharaman said the NDA revived the bank with ₹25,000+ crore recapitalisation.
facts.plain: The government approved selling a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank to Canada's Fairfax Financial Holdings for about ₹53,000 crore; Rahul Gandhi opposed it, citing a 2003 promise to keep 50%. FM Sitharaman said the NDA revived the bank with ₹25,000+ crore recapitalisation.

facts.text: Small finance banks were licensed in 2015-16 following the **Nachiket Mor Committee** (2013) on financial inclusion; they must lend 75% of credit to priority sectors.
facts.plain: Small finance banks were licensed in 2015-16 following the Nachiket Mor Committee (2013) on financial inclusion; they must lend 75% of credit to priority sectors.

facts.text: **Equitas Small Finance Bank** CEO **P.N. Vasudevan** resigned over conflict-of-interest concerns (his daughter runs an NBFC); Equitas became a small finance bank in **2016**.
facts.plain: Equitas Small Finance Bank CEO P.N. Vasudevan resigned over conflict-of-interest concerns (his daughter runs an NBFC); Equitas became a small finance bank in 2016.
